subtitle: Frontend Developer

Shopify Frontend Engineer
infoDesc: I build web applications and e-commerce platforms with JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue, Nuxt, and Shopify. My work spans reusable components, headless storefronts, custom Liquid themes, and responsive interfaces.

At JATAPP, I developed modular product-page components, worked on subscriptions and cart logic, and delivered Amplitude tracking across storefront and checkout. I also built a Cloudflare Workers pipeline for pre-checkout events and cross-domain analytics.

My experience includes Vue Composition API, Pinia, SSR, REST and GraphQL integrations, real-time features with WebSockets, and unit and E2E testing. I have also migrated stores to Shopify and automated product and order workflows with Python, Google Apps Script, Firebase, and Telegram.
